sources.title: AIBrain — Your Agent, Better Every Day
sources.snippet: The Persistent Memory Layer for AI Agents AIBrain is the AI agent memory layer that compounds across every session. It gives any agent a persistent memory layer — plus Agent/Task/Team composition, a Flow engine, document ingestion, universal MCP memory server connectivity, 80 self-learning workflows, mesh networking, and a 60+ page native dashboard.
